## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.  
Fix the save command before merge because it tells callers a report was saved even when the write fails.

## Changes

The pull request adds a function that saves a generated report and announces its destination, plus cleanup that treats an already absent temporary report as expected. This review assessed the added tests by reading them.

## Critical

- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Report write failures and return a nonzero status — A destination under a missing parent directory raises `FileNotFoundError`, which `save_report` catches as `OSError` and discards before printing “Report saved” and returning `0`. — When the destination directory is missing, users and scripts can proceed expecting a report that was never created. — Fix: Include the destination and write error in the failure message, return a nonzero status, and extend `test_save_with_unavailable_destination`.
